contentList.content: Cunning Strike
When you deal Sneak Attack damage, you can forfeit Sneak Attack damage dice to trigger tactical combat effects, debilitating your foes or repositioning yourself across the battlefield.
Cunning Strike: Trip
Forfeit 1d6 Sneak Attack damage on a hit to knock your target Prone unless it succeeds on a Dexterity saving throw.
Cunning Strike: Withdraw
Forfeit 1d6 Sneak Attack damage on a hit to immediately gain Disengage and increase your Movement Speed by 3m until the end of your turn.
Cunning Strike: Poison
Forfeit 1d6 Sneak Attack damage on a hit to coat your weapon in venom, forcing the target to succeed on a Constitution saving throw or become Poisoned for 1 minute.
Cunning Strike: Daze

Forfeit 2d6 Sneak Attack damage on a hit to deliver a concussive strike. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or lose Reactions and be restricted to either an Action or a Bonus Action on its next turn.
Improved Cunning Strike
Your mastery over tactical strikes deepens, unlocking devastating concussive effects such as Daze.
Reliable Talent
By Level 7, your refined expertise ensures steady results under pressure. Whenever you make an Ability Check using a skill in which you have Proficiency, treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10.
Unbound Spellbook
Your arcane versatility expands beyond the schools of Illusion and Enchantment. You may learn and prepare spells freely from the entire Wizard spell list.
Mage Hand Legerdemain
When you cast Mage Hand, the spectral hand is permanently invisible and remains active until dismissed or destroyed. Outside of combat, it can be summoned as a ritual without expending spell slots.
Mage Hand Legerdemain
Summon an invisible, permanent spectral hand that aids you in battle, manipulates objects, and distracts enemies.
Arcane Distraction
Your spectral Mage Hand bedevils adjacent foes. While within 3m of your Mage Hand, enemies suffer the Distracted condition, granting you Advantage on Attack Rolls against them.
Magical Ambush
While you are hidden or invisible to a creature, it has Disadvantage on Saving Throws against spells you cast.
Versatile Trickster
You can project your Cunning Strike riders through your spectral Mage Hand, debilitating distant targets using a Bonus Action.
Spell Thief
When targeted by a spell, you can use your Reaction to attempt to negate the spell's effect and siphon its arcane essence, gaining a free single cast of that spell.
Assassinate
You strike with lethal efficiency before your victims can react. Gain a +2 bonus to Initiative, Advantage against creatures that have not acted, and bonus weapon damage on Round 1.
Assassinate: Combat Readiness
Your razor-sharp reflexes allow you to seize the initiative in any confrontation, granting a +2 bonus to Initiative.
Assassinate: Opening Gambit
You take immediate advantage of unprepared foes, gaining Advantage on Attack Rolls against any creature that has not yet taken a turn in the current combat.
Assassinate: Executioner's Strike

On Round 1 of combat, your weapon attacks against creatures that have not yet taken a turn deal additional weapon damage equal to your Rogue level. Attacks against Surprised creatures score an automatic Critical Hit.
Shadow Dance
When you reduce an enemy to 0 hit points with a weapon attack or score a Critical Hit, you vanish instantly into Invisibility for 1 turn and regain your Reaction.
Penetrating Toxins
Your deadly concoctions bypass biological resilience. Your attacks and venoms ignore Poison Resistance, and creatures with Poison Immunity are treated as having Poison Resistance instead.
Envenomed Strike
Your mastery over lethality infuses your toxins with necrotic bile. When you apply Cunning Strike: Poison, the target suffers an additional 2d6 unresistable Necrotic damage.
Death Strike
When you attack a surprised creature or attack from stealth on Round 1 of combat, the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take double damage from the attack.
Distracted
Harassed by a spectral Mage Hand. Attackers have Advantage on attack rolls against this creature.
Shadow Dance
Veiled in shadows following a lethal strike. You are Invisible for 1 turn and your Reaction has been restored. Invisibility breaks if you attack or cast a spell.
Withdrawn
Swiftly disengaging from the fray. Movement speed is increased by 3m and movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.
Executioner's Strike
Primed for a lethal opener. Weapon attacks against creatures that have not yet taken a turn deal additional damage equal to your Rogue level.
Cunning Poison
Debilitating venom coursing through veins. Creature has Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.
Dazed
Reeling from a concussive strike. The creature cannot take Reactions and can take either an Action or a Bonus Action on its next turn, but not both.
Death Strike
Vulnerable to an executioner's blow. All damage received from the strike is doubled.
